title: Catch a failed call
summary: Lua: Catch a failed call. Replace error with return 8 and check ok.
introduction: pcall runs a function and reports whether it succeeded. The first result is true or false.
learningObjectives: Catch a failed call with Lua
Replace error with return 8 and check ok

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.

blocks.title: Catch a failed call
blocks.code:
local ok = pcall(function() error("Try again") end)
print(ok)

blocks.text: error interrupts the protected function. pcall catches it and returns false first.
Replace error with return 8 and check ok.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The error message is a second result; the first result is the success flag.
